Hi!

I love the dynamic poses you draw with swords!

I'd like to request an artwork to it of my favourite VTuber Tomoe Carmine.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1tR6AJyKwqiB2J1ZrZ1Umnt2Z4S_FNRe7?usp=sharing

She's been playing Elden Ring so I would like to get an artwork in that theme! I particularly like this artwork of yours if it could be a similar pose? https://skeb.jp/@Atelier4402/works/45

She would be using the "Rivers of Blood" Katana
https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/eldenring/images/a/a9/ER_Icon_weapon_Rivers_of_Blood.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/1000?cb=20220411004531

and wearing "Blaidd's Armor"
https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/eldenring/images/0/0c/ER_Icon_Armor_Blaidd%27s_Armor.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/1000?cb=20220410225725

If possible, I'd like if you could please deliver with a transparent version and please have the character in the frame with no hair cut off around the edges.

Tomoe may choose to use this on SNS for her weekly stream schedule or possibly thumbnails!

Thanks for the consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1tR6AJyKwqiB2J1ZrZ1Umnt2Z4S_FNRe7?usp=sharing
